description: Share a table, a view or an application (context) with a user, group, team or federated user. receiverType 'remote' shares a table or view with an account on another Nextcloud, by its Federated Cloud ID (user@cloud.example.com); Tables must allow federation on both sides. An application share gives access to the application with the permissions set on its tables and views, so permissions do not apply to it.

displayMode.description: Applications only: show it in the navigation bar 0 for nobody, 1 for the receivers, 2 for everyone (default)

permissions.description: For tables and views. Default: read only

receiver.description: User ID, group ID, team (circle) ID, or Federated Cloud ID for remote

name: share_table
title: Share Table
